messages:
ana: Quick sync — we're lining up a partner-led launch for a Panama metro region (pan1) with AstraSys (SI) and VertexAccel (hardware). Need a checklist for marketplace listings, capacity reservations, and compliance signoffs. Target: 6 weeks. Who can own which piece? :spiral_calendar:

matt: I can take marketplace listing coord (AWS + GCP). Need SKU names and approved copy from partners. ETA: first draft by Tue.

liam: I'll handle capacity reservations and pool sizing. For initial launch estimate 4xA10G-equivalents and 2 standby nodes. Can we get exact HW SKU from Vertex?

julia (VertexAccel): We can provide 4 x VTX-1000 and 2 x VTX-1000-standby. Passing spec sheet to @matt and @liam now. Note: firmware cert needed for on-prem partners.

ana: oops sorry meant ana :)

ana: @sophia can you confirm compliance checklist for Panama (data residency + local regulator)? Also need MSA addendum for SI installs.

sophia: On it. Panama asks for a security attestation and a copy of vendor export controls. I can draft the addendum but need AstraSys to sign the tech installation SLA pieces.

carlos (AstraSys): We can take tech install SLA. Two asks for our legal: KMS flow (we prefer customer-managed keys via HSM) and a timeline cushion for customs (could be +2 weeks).

matt: Copy for marketplace listing: can partners confirm the 3-line product blurb and logo to avoid delays? I'll draft placeholder: "Redwood Inference — pan1 private region, low-latency inference for LATAM"

julia (VertexAccel): Sending logo + blurb now. Also note thermal constraints for pan1 edge PoP — we recommend 10% headroom on rack power.

liam: Noted on headroom. I'll set capacity request accordingly. Draft capacity request payload below — confirm SKUs and counts so I can submit to cloud ops:

```
region: pan1
partner: astra-vertex
nodes:
  - sku: VTX-1000
    count: 4
  - sku: VTX-1000-standby
    count: 2
requested-by: liam
urgency: medium
notes: customs-buffer +2w, thermal-headroom 10%
```

sophia: Legal will need that payload for the MSA addendum. Also add a clause about data-at-rest encryption (customer-managed keys only).

ana: (typo earlier) — I'm happy to own partner comms and joint announcement cadence. Proposal: internal launch dry-run in 5 weeks, partner readout + press embargo 6 weeks. Thoughts?

matt: Sounds reasonable. I suggest we lock listing copy and logos by EOD Thu to hit that schedule.

carlos (AstraSys): Confirmed on timelines. We'll review SLA draft by Fri and confirm customs window.

ops-bot: Capacity reservation created draft ticket #CR-84321 (pending approval). Link: https://redwoodops/tickets/CR-84321

liam: I'll submit CR-84321 to cloud ops after SKUs are finalized. Action items: (1) Partners provide logo + blurb (julia, carlos) — due Thu EOD; (2) Sophia draft addendum — due Fri; (3) Liam submit capacity req — after SKUs; (4) Matt push marketplace draft — Tue.

ana: Great—I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for weekly syncs starting Monday. :thumbsup:
